items.item: K3 (Chinese short form of the condition in time)
items.how: Read on README-ZH, ONE-PAGE.zh, USES.zh (简言之 and 已证明), OPENING.zh [^present] and [^axiom]: each says 按时间来读，它不能在每一步都成立，因为没有什么能到达过去；若从某一步起来读，它恰在这样的地方成立：从任一步的任一形成出发，经由交换与各自的延续，每一个形成都会在此后某一步被到达, never joined to 只就其后而言 («续无外于后»). GLOSSARY.zh and THE-THEORY.zh §7 give the full form (若要求它对每一步都成立…；它从某一步起的形式是另一个谓词…所到达的步可以各不相同). Kept the short form against verify-screen's alternative: 在每一步都成立 is exactly the unrestricted in-time predicate (every dated formation, earlier steps included, ∀ t), which `Flow.not_unrestricted_inTime` denies, and it stands opposite 从某一步起 as `UnrestrictedEventually`'s ∃ T ∀ t ≥ T does.

items.item: K4 (the direction does not take the condition), Chinese
items.how: 以延续条件、J1–J4 以及与实际系统的对应为前提；其定理取 J1/J2，按各动作的结果所容纳者来比较诸动作，不使用延续条件；在该条件之下来读，所比较的每一项容纳从每一个立场看都算数 stands on ONE-PAGE.zh, THE-THEORY.zh §7, USES.zh; USES-EXAMPLES.zh and GLOSSARY.zh say it at their scope. OPENING.zh [^alignment] said 按诸行动的结果所容纳者来比较诸行动; now 按各动作的结果所容纳者来比较诸动作 (critic 6.3 item 2).

One word: 重合. K5's Chinese said 相合, but 相合 is chapter 6's verdict (相合、定域、相分) on README-ZH, ONE-PAGE.zh, USES.zh, THE-THEORY.zh §6 and the examples, and the eighth-pass Chinese reader had chosen 重合 for two properties coinciding. GLOSSARY.zh:85 and OPENING.zh [^ethics] now say …对每一种次序都重合，恰在…之时, as THE-THEORY.zh:148. The closure-marking theorem (`increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_iff_unrestricted`, (∀ p items O, …) ↔ condition) was said per order in GLOSSARY.zh (对每一个立场、每一个列表与每一种次序，二者恰在…时相合), in OPENING.zh (这一相合对每一个立场…都成立，恰在…) and loosely in THE-THEORY.zh (…都重合，当且仅当…); all three now place the quantifier before the iff: 二者从每一个立场看、在每一个列表上、对每一种次序都重合，恰在延续条件以从己方式成立之时.

Three Chinese definitions stood (verify-dossiers): the fronts' 有一种次序，这里称为自我关切：一个进程扩大另一个时，只要多出的东西里有属于自身延续的，这一次序就把前者排在后者之上；这里把自身的延续读作自身所能到达的一切 (README-ZH, ONE-PAGE.zh, USES.zh, BUDDHIST-THOUGHT; Fable praised its lead), the anchor's 一个生命对诸进程的次序，若把每一个给自身的延续有所增加的扩大，都排在被它扩大者之上，就称为自我关切的 (GLOSSARY.zh, THE-THEORY.zh), and 若凡对自身的延续有所增加的扩大…就是自我关切的 (06, OPENING.zh notes, CLASSICAL-TEXTS dossier), with the cover's 随自身延续而递增的次序（自我关切：…） and the examples' long prenominal modifiers. Every Chinese page now carries the fronts' one sentence, its lead fitted to the page (the glossary's 生命对诸进程的一种次序：…, 06's 自我关切是生命对诸进程的一种次序：…, the notes' 条 as their measure word for 进程). 06 §426 now points to the definition at 基与标 instead of saying it twice. The 'scope' sense of §4.3 is named in GLOSSARY.zh (另有一种用法…) as the glossary agent wrote it. ONE-PAGE.zh and THE-THEORY.zh §10 no longer gloss self-concern a second way (随自身延续而递增的次序（自我关切） → 自我关切的次序).

items.how: 在 07 §4.9 所述的活动、支撑与世系假设之下 on README-ZH, ONE-PAGE.zh (and 尚未完成), USES.zh (twice), THE-THEORY.zh §7 and §10, GLOSSARY.zh, 06 and OPENING.zh [^ethics] (bold and body). 世系 kept for the line and for descent (世系假设), as GLOSSARY.zh and the vernacular records (以之为生与世系) say descent; the classical records now say 传承 in all three (what-persisting-shows-of-an-order said 传代).

README-ZH, USES.zh and the cover say 这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制; one term 联合选择 on every Chinese front (the screen's 共同选择 is gone). ONE-PAGE.zh and THE-THEORY.zh give the first half, as their English (Ren's choice, FOR-REN-opening (f)); AJ's condition-1 wording stays only where the goal's conditions are listed (ONE-PAGE.zh, THE-THEORY.zh §7, USES.zh 人与 AI 共处, USES-EXAMPLES.zh), labelled.

这一论证路线 beside 两条水平路径 (这条路径 remains only for 07 §4.6's path and a reading path); 这一次序就 (no 它就); 世系; the plain persisting sentence on every front, GLOSSARY.zh adding （对已作选择的一道筛选）; 在能判定容纳与否时; 这里把自身的延续读作自身所能到达的一切, and 之内者 gone from OPENING.zh [^axiom], [^ethics] (读作其中心沿某个关系所能到达的一切) and THE-THEORY.zh §7 (读作其闭包之内的一切); 每一个延续都能; （其逆未证） only at the path result: OPENING.zh had it after 这已证明 (covering the finite listing, where the converse holds: `increasingInOwn_of_increasing`, the iff) and after 也可以为别的进程对排序 (the English: may rank other pairs too); moved to the path clause, and removed there; 06:426's C gloss carries its living reading.

3.1 之内者: fixed on the fronts (this pass) and now in the notes and the overview; 3.2 每一个的行为: gone (K3); 3.3 都能: one; 3.4 在能判定容纳与否时: one; 3.5 （其逆未证）: one, and placed only at the path result; 3.6 the praised phrases kept (扩大，就是更多的未来; 有一种次序，这里称为自我关切; 扩大所多出的东西都在生命自身所能到达的范围之内; 跨越所有步来读，即把不同时刻的影响合在一起看; 所以这一论证路线对它什么也没有说; 这里比较的是两个进程各容纳什么).
